justification: Both surfaces show schematic animals in profile scattered or grouped around larger forms, with small repeated sign-like motifs, which is about as generic a correspondence as two unrelated traditions could produce. A is dominated by a single large frontal anthropomorph with raised arm gripping a long tapering object, with no register system, whereas B organises stacked rows of animals, a banded pattern and a large bird-like creature into horizontal registers with no human figure.
